name: Episode Limit
overview: Stop playback after X files - perfect for falling asleep!
description: Adds a bedtime button to the video player that lets you set how many files to play before automatically stopping. Works with episodes, movies, anything!

versions.changelog: v2.0.0.0 - per-user tracking (fixes silently broken counting), stop deduplication (fixes double-counting on Android), accurate log names, verified enforcement with retries, automatic script registration via the JavaScript Injector (install.sh retired). Requires the JavaScript Injector plugin.
